title: Sanitation infrastructure, environmental vulnerability, and hepatitis A in South Korea (analysis code and compiled data, v2.0.1)
description: Corrected, submission-aligned reproducibility package for a Bayesian spatiotemporal analysis of district-level hepatitis A incidence across 223 South Korean districts, 2020-2024 (negative binomial, Besag-York-Mollie convolution + RW1 + Knorr-Held Type I interaction, fitted with R-INLA). Contains the R script for the final 27-covariate model, the compiled 1,112-row district-year analytic dataset, principal-model incidence-rate ratios, model-comparison and spatial-residual diagnostics, CPO/PIT values, a VIF audit, run logs and R/INLA session information. The final covariate specification was developed exploratorily; the reported credible associations are hypothesis-generating. Supersedes v1.x, which carried the pre-correction script and no compiled data.
